newsitem.title: USA: Busse Broadcasting ends evaluation of deals.
newsitem.headline: Busse Broadcasting ends evaluation of deals.

text.p: Busse Broadcasting Corp said Friday its controlling stockholders directed Morgan Stanley & Co to suspend evaluation of transactions in connection with the possible sale of the company.
Morgan Stanley will continue to act as a financial advisor to the controlling stockholders, it added.
The company said it can make no assurance whether or when its controlling stockholders will resume evaluation of a possible sale of the firm.

The company owns and operates KOLN/KGIN-TV, a CBS affiliate serving Lincoln and Grand Island, Neb.; WEAU-TV, a NBC affiliate serving Eau Claire and La Crosse, Wis.; and Winnebago Color Press, a commercial printer, located in Menasha, Wis.
